name: Retro Diffusion
author: lviit
description: Retro Diffusion plan usage and balance in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Click: usage panel. Middle click: refresh. Right click: open Retro Diffusion in the browser.

schema.label: Refresh in the background
schema.description: Ask api.retrodiffusion.ai for your usage on a timer. When off, the widget only asks when you open the panel, middle-click it, or press R.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask the Retro Diffusion API for your usage. Opening the panel always refreshes.

schema.label: Value shown on the bar
schema.description: plan: plan usage left (falls back to balance without an active plan). balance: prepaid USD balance.

schema.label: Show the value next to the icon
Warn when plan usage left is at or below (%)
